message: You're done wasting your time on me? How rich. You're the one who's been wasting everyone's time with your incoherent ramblings and your desperate attempts to cling to a fantasy world where guns are the answer to every problem. Newsflash: you're not even a good troll, you're just a coward who can't handle the fact that your arguments are getting destroyed one by one. You're a joke, and not even a funny one - you're a sad, pathetic excuse for a human being who's more interested in virtue-signaling and scoring points with your fellow ideologues than in actually engaging in a real conversation. You're a hypocrite who claims to care about the lives of others but is too afraid to actually take a stand on anything. And you know what the worst part is? You're not even a good liar. Your attempts to spin this as some kind of "attack" on your precious freedoms are transparently laughable, and everyone who's been paying attention can see right through it. So here's the deal: either get your facts straight, or get out of here. Because right now, you're not even worthy of the title "opponent".

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'coward', 'sad, pathetic excuse for a human being', and 'not even a good liar'.  These are direct attacks on the person's character and worth, not their argument.
